Welcome to the
Underwater Dance Party!

Where a fish and an octopus learn to move, talk, and dance

Class 1 · Today's Agenda

What Are We Building Today?

Here's our plan for this class.

Meet ScratchJr

We'll open the app and start a brand-new project together.

Bring Our Fish to Life

We'll make our fish move, turn, and dance across the stage.

Set the Ocean Scene

We'll add an underwater background and a dancing friend.

Our Agreements

Our ScratchJr Rules

Simple rules that keep our coding time fun and safe for everyone.

Ask before deleting

We check with our teacher before tapping the red X.

One helper at a time

We take turns tapping the tablet and share nicely.

Try, don't worry

Mistakes are part of coding — we just tap Undo and try again.

CLASS 1 · STEP 1 OF 10

Open the App & Create a Project

  • Tap Home, then tap the + to start a brand-new project.
  • Every new project begins with the ScratchJr cat standing on stage.
CLASS 1 · STEP 2 OF 10

Turn the Cat into a Fish

  • Delete the cat: press and hold, then tap the red X.
  • Tap + and choose a fish from the Animals category.
CLASS 1 · STEP 3 OF 10

Make the Fish Move

  • Tap the blue Motion blocks.
  • Drag arrow blocks into the programming area and tap them to test.
  • Try the turn block too, for a swirly swim!
CLASS 1 · STEP 4 OF 10

Add the Green Flag Block

  • Tap the yellow Trigger blocks.
  • Snap Start on Green Flag to the front of your script.
  • Tap the green flag at the top to run the whole script!
CLASS 1 · STEP 5 OF 10

Change the Background to the Ocean

  • Tap the Background button (the little picture icon).
  • Pick an underwater background and tap the checkmark.
CLASS 1 · STEP 6 OF 10

Add the Octopus

  • Tap + in the character area to add a second character.
  • Choose an octopus (or any sea friend!) and tap the checkmark.

Great First Splash!

Our fish is swimming and the octopus has joined the party. Next class, we'll make the octopus talk and finish the show!

Class 2 · Welcome Back!

What Did We Build Last Time?

Let's remember before we continue our underwater party.

Our fish swims

It moves, turns, and starts dancing with the green flag.

Our ocean stage

We picked an underwater background for the show.

Our octopus joined

A second character is ready to become part of the show.

CLASS 2 · STEP 7 OF 10

Make the Octopus Talk

  • Tap the purple Looks blocks.
  • Drag the Say block into the programming area.
  • Tap the text and type something fun, like "Let's dance!"
CLASS 2 · STEP 8 OF 10

Green Flag for Everyone!

  • Add motion blocks and a green flag block to the octopus too.
  • Tap the green flag — both characters play at the same time!
CLASS 2 · STEP 9 OF 10

Add a Title

  • Tap Add Text at the top of the stage.
  • Type a title, like "Underwater Dance Party".
CLASS 2 · STEP 10 OF 10

Name & Save the Project

  • Tap the yellow tab and type your project's name.
  • Tap Home to save and return to My Projects.
Class 2 · Bonus Challenge

Level Up the Party!

Finished early? Try one of these:

  • Add a Repeat block so the dance loops again and again.
  • Record a sound so your octopus has its own voice.
  • Add a third sea friend with its own script!

See You Next Time, Ocean Coders!

You built, you coded, you danced — amazing work today!
